pattern: store root or kept path hard-coded in business code
attainable_ceiling: 4: the path has no spelling outside its declaration
red_control: a fixture module naming "/var/lib/gunbc/x" outside the directory declaration is refused

pattern: kept record written raw (overwrite, own codec) where a store library exists (mechanism=none-raw)
attainable_ceiling: 4: a raw kept-path write has no constructor once stores are handles
wall: type: kept records are writable only through a store handle
red_control: a fixture business module writing Filesystem.Write to a kept path is refused
next_trigger: kept-path writes go through a store handle

pattern: repo-relative literal path for a receipt or artifact
red_control: a fixture module naming "target/x-receipt.txt" is refused

pattern: host or instance re-selected downstream of an entry (srv1_live_dashboard_instance() wrappers, per-host fns, host == srvN guards)
wall: admit_callers roster: only entry points may call the instance selectors
red_control: a fixture non-entry fn calling srv1_live_dashboard_instance() is refused
residual: operator-facing CLIs that are entries by design

pattern: credential or secret location hard-coded (or re-implemented) in business code
wall: type: a secret is reachable only through a SecretAccessGrant
red_control: a fixture module opening a key path literal is refused
residual: bootstrap secrets before any grant exists

pattern: own create-once / lock / compare-and-set beside the CAS library
attainable_ceiling: 3: the primitive is a modeled effect, so its callers are a decidable set
wall: admit_callers roster on the exclusive-create primitive (only the CAS store may call it)
red_control: a fixture business module calling Filesystem.WriteCreateNew directly is refused
residual: stores whose head semantics the CAS contract does not cover

pattern: resource location or identity reached through an ambient environment variable
wall: declared requires: an entry declares the env it reads
red_control: a fixture fn calling shell.Env.Get outside an entry declaration is refused

pattern: systemd unit name or unit directory hard-coded
owning_authority: none exists: unit-directory choice (extdeps.systemd lists legal locations)
red_control: a fixture naming "/etc/systemd/system/" outside the deployment declaration is refused

pattern: module creates its own directories (and modes) beside the owned/managed directory authority
attainable_ceiling: 3: directory creation is a modeled effect
red_control: a fixture module calling shell.Mkdir.Parents on a store root is refused

pattern: module deletes or sweeps kept data by hand
red_control: a fixture module calling shell.Remove.RecursiveForce on a kept root is refused
next_trigger: retention owned by the directory authority

pattern: host, instance id or address literal in business code
red_control: a fixture naming "srv1" outside the fleet declaration is refused

pattern: process-wide memo table with a hand-authored key and no invalidation (OnceLock / thread_local / static map)
attainable_ceiling: 2 in the seed (validation over Rust); 4 in v2 (memo is a provider binding)
wall: declared requires: a memo needs an admitted provider and key
red_control: a seed fn adding a static OnceLock memo without a provider row is refused

pattern: upstream program location named in business code (ruling b)
red_control: a fixture naming "/usr/bin/systemctl" outside the environment declaration is refused

pattern: fixed /tmp file or directory name for kept or shared data
red_control: a fixture module naming "/tmp/gunbc-x.json" outside the scratch grant is refused

pattern: access path re-selected per host or per caller instead of received
wall: type: access is a parameter of the host row
red_control: a fixture branching on host identity to pick access is refused

pattern: kernel ABI or upstream-constant path read directly (ruling d)
wall: derived from the extdeps interface model
red_control: a fixture reading "/proc/self/cgroup" outside extdeps is refused

pattern: behaviour switches on the environment (CI variables, env-selected instance)
owning_authority: gunbc.ci.* (no CI-environment authority consumed by the seed)
red_control: a fixture branching on GITHUB_ACTIONS outside an entry is refused

pattern: privileged effect performed by ambient sudo rather than a received capability
wall: declared requires: the effect names its authorization pattern
red_control: a fixture sudo_elevate site absent from the selection is refused
residual: bootstrap of the grant machinery itself

pattern: port or listen address hard-coded
red_control: a fixture binding a literal port is refused

pattern: endpoint, user or identity to call as, hard-coded
red_control: a fixture naming a login or endpoint literal outside the roster is refused

pattern: device node named in business code (ruling d)
owning_authority: host or instance declaration naming the device
red_control: a fixture naming "/dev/vdb" outside the host row is refused

pattern: store root re-derived from an authority the module was (or could be) handed
wall: type: the store handle is the parameter, not the instance
red_control: a fixture that receives stores and re-derives a root from the instance is refused

pattern: authorization decided locally (token read, standing composed in place)
wall: type: the capability is the parameter
red_control: a fixture composing a standing from a read token is refused

pattern: cache directory chosen by literal in business code
red_control: a fixture naming a cache root literal is refused

pattern: emitter template wraps every nullary constant in a thread_local memo
red_control: an emitted constant with a CACHED wrapper is refused by the emit census
